reasoning: Roofline marks this kernel as underutilized (Compute SOL 54.8%, Memory SOL 36.4%, not at roofline). Tensor path is unused (0%), and achieved DRAM bandwidth (~1.17 TB/s) is far below MI300X peak (5.3 TB/s), indicating headroom is lost to execution inefficiencies rather than pure compute or memory limits.

root_causes.cause: No matrix-core/tensor-core utilization for GEMM, limiting arithmetic throughput on CDNA3.

evidence.interpretation: Tensor/matrix execution units are completely idle during matmul.

fixes.fix: Retune/force Triton configs that map `tl.dot` to MFMA (matrix cores), e.g., use MI300X-friendly block shapes and mixed-precision paths (fp16/bf16 inputs with fp32 accumulate) known to trigger matrix instructions.
fixes.rationale: Activating MFMA/tensor paths can substantially raise compute SOL and move the kernel closer to the roofline.

root_causes.cause: On-chip memory access inefficiency from significant LDS bank conflicts creates stall overhead despite high warp occupancy.

evidence.interpretation: High LDS bank conflict count suggests shared-memory contention and serialization.

fixes.fix: Change tile layout/access pattern to reduce LDS conflicts (e.g., add padding/skew to shared tiles, adjust BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N/BLOCK_K so per-wave LDS strides avoid same-bank hits).
fixes.rationale: Reducing bank conflicts lowers latency stalls and improves both effective compute and memory utilization.
